children: Robinhood Markets, Inc. Class A (NASDAQ:HOOD) posted user and asset growth and closed the Bitstamp buy, struck deals with OG.com/Crypto.com to run Prediction Markets, clarified tokenized-stock mechanics, faces French regulator scrutiny over OGC Nice sponsorship, and readies AI and ETF initiatives.
Robinhood Markets, Inc. Class A Highlights: 28.6M Funded; 384B Assets; 4B Net Deposits; 335B Equity Notional; 293M Options; Crypto 17.5B
: HOOD: Funded customers 28.6M (+1.9M YoY), platform assets $384B (+26% YoY, +8% MoM), net deposits $4B. August equity notional $335B (ADV $16.0B); options 293M contracts (ADV 13.9M); crypto $17.5B.

: Robinhood (HOOD) struck a multi-year deal with OG.com and Crypto.com: OG.com will clear and run Robinhood’s Prediction Markets via Robinhood Derivatives, LLC. Phased U.S. rollout starts Sept 8, 2026.
: Robinhood (HOOD) CEO Vlad Tenev said third‑party tokenized stocks are 1:1 backed, give economic exposure without changing cap tables or shareholder rights, and token holders lack voting rights.
: HOOD closed its June 2025 acquisition of Bitstamp, gaining an institutional exchange, API infrastructure, 50+ licenses/registrations, and UK crypto service supporting 50+ digital assets.
France Probes HOOD OGC Nice Sponsorship
: France's gambling regulator is reviewing Robinhood Markets Class A (HOOD) front-of-shirt sponsorship of OGC Nice to assess whether the deal promotes prediction-market activities in France.
: Analyst notes agentic AI trading may benefit Robinhood Markets (HOOD), positioning it competitively versus Schwab and alongside Interactive Brokers as brokerages adopt AI trading tech.
HOOD Named Initial Broker for Kids ETF
: Proposal names Robinhood Markets, Inc. Class A (HOOD) as initial broker and trustee for a kids’ U.S. stock ETF program, coordinated with BNY Mellon, Treasury and IRS; contributions possible.
